name: Demonfire Command cuts Implosion's cooldown from 40 to 30 sec (#790)
contract: Demonfire Command 707028 (CharacterAdvancement 6860, Defiance, one rank) reads 'Reduces the cooldown of Implosion by $/1000;s1 sec.' In Spell.dbc its only effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) on the caster, MiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), BasePoints -10001 with DieSides 1 = -10000 ms, EffectSpellClassMask dword0 0x10000000 with SpellFamilyName 23. Implosion 524897 is SpellFamilyName 23 with SpellFamilyFlags dword0 0x10000000 and RecoveryTime 40000 (no category recovery), so the native Player::ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN) in the cooldown path must make its cooldown 30000 ms; no CoA code handles 707028. Implosion needs a Demonfire (500906) aura to cast (CasterAuraSpell), so the fixture grants one stack before each cast. The same knight casts Implosion before and after the talent.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: no cooldown modifier applies to Implosion before the talent
SETUP: Implosion goes on its full 40 sec cooldown
Force the Demonfire Command passive aura
Let the passive's modifier and any global cooldown settle
CONTRACT: the cooldown modifier takes 10 sec off Implosion
Grant Demonfire again for the second Implosion
CONTRACT: Implosion now goes on a 30 sec cooldown
